title: Peruvian-Style Grilled Pork Tenderloin with Chupe
description: A flavorful Peruvian-inspired dish featuring a tender grilled pork tenderloin served with a side of chupe, a traditional Peruvian corn and potato stew.
instructions: Season pork tenderloin with chupe spices, salt, and pepper.
Grill pork tenderloin for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add pre-cooked chupe and stir to combine.
Season chupe with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve grilled pork tenderloin with a side of chupe.
